{
  "findings": [
    {
      "title": "Inconsistent estimand description for PRO: Week 12 vs Week 14",
      "quote": "Change from baseline to Week 14 in PRO endpoints between AMG 510 and docetaxel",
      "page": 10,
      "section": "1.1 Synopsis",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "critical",
      "explanation": "The PRO estimand description states 'Week 14' while the endpoint definition and all other references specify 'Week 12'. This discrepancy will cause confusion in analysis and reporting.",
      "fix": "Change 'Week 14' to 'Week 12' in the PRO estimand description."
    },
    {
      "title": "Incomplete sentence in PRO estimand description",
      "quote": "for with KRAS p.G12C mutation.",
      "page": 10,
      "section": "1.1 Synopsis",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "critical",
      "explanation": "The sentence is grammatically incomplete, missing the subject 'subjects'. This makes the estimand description unclear.",
      "fix": "Revise to 'for subjects with KRAS p.G12C mutation.'"
    },
    {
      "title": "Inconsistent crossover description: 'early efficacy' vs 'interim analysis'",
      "quote": "should an early efficacy of the study be noted by the DMC, crossover will be considered for all subjects who randomized into the docetaxel arm",
      "page": 10,
      "section": "1.1 Synopsis",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The phrase 'early efficacy' is vague and not defined elsewhere. It is unclear whether this refers to an interim analysis, a futility analysis, or an unplanned review. This ambiguity could lead to misinterpretation of the crossover rules.",
      "fix": "Specify the exact condition (e.g., 'if the interim analysis shows a statistically significant PFS benefit') and reference the relevant section."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing definition of 'treatment beyond progression'",
      "quote": "Subjects that consent to treatment beyond progression or consent to crossover, from docetaxel to AMG 510, will continu",
      "page": 10,
      "section": "1.1 Synopsis",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The sentence is cut off and does not specify the conditions, duration, or assessments for treatment beyond progression. This is a critical operational detail.",
      "fix": "Complete the sentence and provide details on treatment beyond progression, including criteria, duration, and monitoring."
    },
    {
      "title": "Inconsistent tumor assessment schedule: 'every 6 weeks' vs 'at weeks 7, 13, 19...'",
      "quote": "every 6 weeks from cycle 1 day 1; (± 7 days) (at weeks 7, 13, 19, 25, 31, 37, 43, and 49)",
      "page": 10,
      "section": "1.1 Synopsis",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The text says 'every 6 weeks' but then lists weeks 7, 13, 19, etc., which are 6-week intervals starting at week 7, not week 6. This inconsistency could lead to scheduling errors.",
      "fix": "Clarify whether the first assessment is at week 6 or week 7, and align the text accordingly."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing details on stratification factors",
      "quote": "Subjects will be stratified by number of prior lines of therapy in advanced disease (1 versus 2 versus > 2), race (Asian versus non-Asian), and history of central nervous system (CNS) involvement (present or absent).",
      "page": 10,
      "section": "1.1 Synopsis",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "The stratification factors are listed but not defined in detail (e.g., how 'history of CNS involvement' is assessed, whether it includes treated/stable brain metastases). This could lead to inconsistent stratification at sites.",
      "fix": "Add definitions and assessment methods for each stratification factor."
    },
    {
      "title": "Inconsistent reference to 'Section 99.1.6'",
      "quote": "See Section 99.1.6 and Section 8.1.7 for AMG 510 and docetaxel treatment beyond radiologic progression.",
      "page": 10,
      "section": "1.1 Synopsis",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "Section 99.1.6 is not a standard section number and likely a placeholder. This makes it impossible for readers to locate the referenced information.",
      "fix": "Replace 'Section 99.1.6' with the correct section number."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing definition of 'early efficacy' and DMC role",
      "quote": "should an early efficacy of the study be noted by the DMC",
      "page": 10,
      "section": "1.1 Synopsis",
      "category": "advisory",
      "severity": "advisory",
      "explanation": "The role of the DMC in determining 'early efficacy' is not defined, and the criteria for such a decision are not specified. This could lead to operational and ethical concerns.",
      "fix": "Define the DMC's role, the statistical criteria for early efficacy, and the process for implementing crossover."
    }
  ]
}
